tool.name: Manipulate AnnData
tool.description: Manipulate AnnData datasets with various operations
tool.help:
# AnnData Manipulation Tool
This tool performs various manipulations on AnnData datasets. Operations include:
- Concatenation of datasets - Making observation and variable names unique - Renaming categories - Removing keys - Flagging genes - Converting strings to categoricals - Transposing data - Adding annotations - Splitting by observation keys - Filtering data - Freezing raw data
### Input - AnnData file in .loom format
### Output - Manipulated AnnData file in .loom format
### Example ```bash anndata-manipulate --input input.loom --operation concatenate --output output.loom ```
